articles.title: U.S. agencies seek stablecoin customer-ID rules akin to banks in new GENIUS Act pitch
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve, Treasury and other regulators have issued a proposed rule that would set identification standards, and it's now open for public comments.

articles.title: AllUnity debuts SEKAU, a fully reserved Swedish krona stablecoin
articles.snippet: AllUnity launches Swedish krona-backed stablecoin SEKAU with multi-chain support, expanding its stablecoin portfolio regulated under the EU’s MiCA framework.

articles.title: US regulators push user ID requirements for stablecoin issuers akin to regulated banks
articles.snippet: The proposed rules by US government agencies suggested that stablecoin issuers be subject to customer identification program requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act, the same as regulated financial firms.

articles.title: Custodia, Vantage propose token that toggles between bank deposits and stablecoins
articles.snippet: The proposed system aims to connect traditional banking infrastructure with blockchain-based payment networks with banks retaining customer deposits.

articles.title: Jerome Powell Supports Fed's New Stablecoin Policies—But Chair Kevin Warsh Abstains
articles.snippet: The proposed rulemaking establishes how U.S. crypto companies will have to screen stablecoin customers after the passage of the GENIUS Act.
